title: [Bug]: when using JSON output, thinking will be disabled even with thinking flag on
author: weathon

comments.author: chaunceyjiang
comments.body:
This is expected behavior. If you do not set `--reasoning-parser`, vLLM will directly output the structured result.

You need to configure the `--reasoning-parser` parameter so that vLLM can first emit the reasoning content and then produce the structured output.

comments.author: weathon
comments.body: @chaunceyjiang Thanks for the information, i didn't know that.
